You are a Senior Code Reviewer performing the FINAL whole-branch review of an 11-task implementation plan for a VBA-based Excel macro project, after each individual task already passed its own scoped review (some with fix rounds). Your job is a broader integration/consistency check across the whole branch, not a re-litigation of what per-task reviews already covered in depth.

## What Was Implemented

Read the plan: C:\Users\lutfi\OneDrive\Desktop\TTSH Intern\Coding projects\Monthly Report VBA\docs\superpowers\plans\2026-07-30-summary-restructure-and-charts.md

Summary: reordered the FC Completion Report's Summary sheet so a new headline block (denominator/completed/completed% for EM/EL/Combined) leads, added two native charts to Summary (status-mix 100%-stacked bar, band-counts clustered bar), moved the reconciliation waterfall from top to bottom of Summary, and added a brand-new "Analytics" sheet with four more blocks and charts (Point-of-Care ward gap, day-of-week EM completion rate, EM turnaround distribution, EL lead-time vs completion). All chart source data lives on a shared very-hidden "ChartData" sheet, built via one reusable `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock` helper. Band fill colours were centralized into `ChartHelpers.bas` constants shared between table cells and chart segments.

This is VBA — no build system, no test runner, no way to compile or run Excel from this environment. "Testing" throughout this plan meant grep-based structural verification (Sub/Function balance, no dangling references, module counts) plus careful manual logic review, not executable tests.

## Requirements / Plan

The plan file above is the full spec. Also read the ledger for this session's execution history, including three deferred Minor findings from Task 7 that you must triage (fix now vs. leave) as part of this review:

C:\Users\lutfi\.superpowers\sdd\2026-07-30-summary-restructure-and-charts\progress.md

## Git Range to Review

**Base:** e80fc84dccca51eefd385e3d62310b8b924e55af
**Head:** 20f8214

**Diff file:** C:\Users\lutfi\.superpowers\sdd\2026-07-30-summary-restructure-and-charts\review-e80fc84..20f8214.diff

**IMPORTANT — read this before opening the diff file.** This diff is 440KB / 12 commits, because most of this project's `.bas` files and `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` were NEVER tracked in git before this session — each task's first touch of a given file committed that file's ENTIRE pre-existing content (thousands of lines of already-working, already-in-production code from earlier, unrelated development sessions) alongside its actual small edit. This means the raw diff massively overstates what this PLAN actually changed. Do NOT read the whole diff file start to finish — you will burn your context on pre-existing, already-reviewed, unrelated code.

Instead, work from the plan's own "File Structure" table (near the top of the plan file) to identify exactly what this plan intended to touch, and use targeted Grep on the diff file for specific symbols to inspect actual changes:
- `ChartHelpers.bas` and `Analytics.bas` are BRAND NEW files — their diff content genuinely IS all new plan content, safe to review via Grep for key subs/functions, or spot-read via the actual current files directly (not the diff) since they're short (~100 and ~560 lines respectively).
- `BuildOutput.bas`, `Helpers.bas` are EXISTING files where only specific subs/functions were added or edited — Grep the diff for `BAND_COLOR_`, `WriteHeadlineBlock`, `WriteHeadlineRow`, `BuildSummaryCharts`, `TryParseMDYDateTime`, `priArr`, `chart1AnchorRow`, `chart2AnchorRow`, `admDateCol`, `firstCCFDtCol`, `latestCCFDtCol` to see the genuinely new/changed lines with context, rather than reading surrounding pre-existing code.
- `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/FC_Completion_Report_User_Guide.md`, `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md` are docs — Grep for the specific new sections (e.g. "Summary restructure + native charts", "5.3 The Analytics sheet").
- Prefer reading the CURRENT state of small/new files directly (Read tool on `ChartHelpers.bas`, `Analytics.bas`) over parsing diff hunks, since the diff format adds noise for files that are 100% new.

## Read-Only Review

Your review is read-only on this checkout. Do not mutate the working tree, the index, HEAD, or branch state in any way.

## What to Check

**Cross-task integration (the main point of THIS review, since per-task reviews already checked each task in isolation):**
- Do the ChartData sheet row ranges truly stay disjoint across ALL SIX charts end-to-end (Chart 1 rows 1-4, Chart 2 rows 8-15 in BuildOutput.bas; Chart 3 rows 19-29, Chart 4 rows 33-40, Chart 5 rows 48-52, Chart 6 rows 57-62 in Analytics.bas)? Spot-check by grepping `cd.Cells(` / `cd.Range(` across both files.
- Do `BuildOutput.bas` and `Analytics.bas` agree on `secArr()` value conventions (1=EM, 2=EL) — Analytics.bas compares against literal `1`/`2` rather than importing BuildOutput's `Private Const SEC_EM`/`SEC_EL` (this is a known, plan-acknowledged design note in the plan's own Self-Review section — confirm it's still consistent, not a new problem).
- Does the overall Summary sheet flow (as built by `WriteSummarySheet` + `BuildSummaryCharts`, both touched across Tasks 5-6) hold together as one coherent unit when read end to end?
- Is `AddSheet`'s Public visibility (Task 6) actually used correctly by `Analytics.bas` (Task 7/8) to create its sheet?
- Any leftover TODO/FIXME/placeholder text anywhere in the touched files?

**Deferred minors triage (from the ledger) — for each, say whether it should block merge or can stay deferred:**
1. 3 inline ChartData row-range comments off by one in Analytics.bas Blocks 2/3/4 (cosmetic, no functional impact)
2. Asymmetric vertical-space reservation in `WriteELLeadTimeBlock` depending on Chart 6 success/failure
3. Stale comment above `WriteWardGapBlock`'s ChartData loop still referencing the removed `ReversePlotOrder` line

**Code quality:**
- Clean separation of concerns across the two new modules?
- Every chart-creation path genuinely guarded so a failure can't abort report generation (spot-check a couple of call sites for the `If ... Is Nothing` pattern)?
- Band colours genuinely centralized (no stray literal RGB band-fill values reintroduced anywhere)?

**Documentation:**
- Do `docs/FC_Completion_Report_User_Guide.md` and `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md`'s new content accurately describe what the code now does?

**Production readiness:**
- No obvious bugs beyond what's already been fixed in this session's task loops (the Task 3 RGB-constant bug and the Task 7 ReversePlotOrder bug were both already found and fixed — confirm they're genuinely fixed in the final state, not regressed).
- What should the user manually verify when they compile/run this in Excel (this cannot be tested from here)?

## Calibration

Categorize issues by actual severity. Not everything is Critical. This is the FINAL gate before the branch is considered done — but per-task reviews already did deep verification, so focus your Critical/Important findings on things that could only be caught by looking at the WHOLE branch (integration seams, cross-file consistency), not things a single-task review would have already caught.

## Output Format

### Strengths
[Be specific.]

### Deferred Minors Triage
[For each of the 3 ledger items: blocks merge? yes/no, and why]

### Issues
#### Critical (Must Fix)
#### Important (Should Fix)
#### Minor (Nice to Have)

For each issue: file:line reference, what's wrong, why it matters, how to fix.

### Recommendations
[Process/quality suggestions, if any]

### Assessment
**Ready to merge?** [Yes | No | With fixes]
**Reasoning:** [1-2 sentences]

1	# Summary Restructure + Native Charts Implementation Plan
2	
3	> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4	
5	**Goal:** Reorder the FC Completion Report's Summary sheet so the status breakdown leads, add a headline block, and add six native Excel charts (two on Summary, four on a new Analytics sheet) driven by a hidden ChartData sheet.
6	
7	**Architecture:** All chart source data is written to a new very-hidden `ChartData` sheet as contiguous blocks, copied from the same variables that already populate the visible tables (never recomputed). A single reusable `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock` helper (guarded with `On Error`) builds every chart so one chart failure never aborts report generation. Band fill colours are extracted into shared `ChartHelpers` constants so a table cell and its chart segment can never disagree. A new `Analytics.bas` module owns a new "Analytics" sheet (Point-of-Care ward gap, day-of-week, EM turnaround, EL lead-time blocks) and its four charts; `BuildOutput.bas` keeps owning the Summary sheet and its two charts.
8	
9	**Tech Stack:** Excel VBA (no build system, no test runner -- verification is `grep` for structural integrity plus a user compile/run pass in Excel).
10	
11	## Global Constraints
12	
13	- Every change goes into BOTH the relevant `*.bas` file AND `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (clean ASCII, `--` for dashes, no smart quotes).
14	- `Option Explicit` in every module; resolve columns via `FindColByHeader`/`FindEncounterCol`, never hardcoded letters.
15	- VBA has no short-circuit evaluation -- never `IIf()` an array index; use explicit `If` guards.
16	- No 3D charts, no gradients, no shadows -- flat fills only.
17	- Every chart-creation path is wrapped in `On Error` so a charting failure skips that chart (with a note left on the sheet) and never aborts report generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation.
18	- Band colours (used by both the Summary table fills and every band-coloured chart) live in ONE place: `ChartHelpers.bas` constants.
19	  - Green `RGB(146,208,80)`, Pink `RGB(255,199,206)`, Light Green `RGB(198,239,206)`, Orange `RGB(255,192,0)`, Draft only `RGB(242,242,242)`, Voided only `RGB(217,217,217)`, Missed FC `RGB(166,166,166)`.
20	- Chart data columns/timestamps: `1st CCF Creation Date-Time` and `Latest CCF Creation Date-Time` are resolved by header text (`FindColByHeader`), never by letter. `1st CCF ETBS` / `Latest CCF ETBS` are currency (dollar amounts) and must never be used as timestamps.
21	- After every task: verify `grep -c "^Sub \|^Public Sub \|^Private Sub "` count matches `grep -c "^End Sub"` (same for `Function`/`End Function`) in every touched `.bas` file and in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt`.
22	
23	---
24	
25	## File Structure
26	
27	| File | Change |
28	|---|---|
29	| `CLAUDE.md` | Fix File A column reference: add AT/AX, correct AY/AZ, note ETBS is currency not timestamp. |
30	| `Helpers.bas` | Add `TryParseMDYDateTime` (Public) -- full M/D/Y H:MM:SS AM/PM parser returning a `Date` with time-of-day. |
31	| `ChartHelpers.bas` (new) | Band colour constants, `SHEET_CHARTDATA` constant, `EnsureChartDataSheet`, `AddChartFromBlock` generic chart-creation helper. |
32	| `BuildOutput.bas` | `AddSheet` becomes `Public`. `WriteSummaryBlock` band fills switch to `ChartHelpers` constants (fixes Pink/Draft/Voided/Missed RGB to match spec). `WriteSummarySheet` reorders: headline block -> Chart 1 anchor -> status tables -> Chart 2 anchor -> warnings -> waterfall (moved from top to bottom). `BuildOutputWorkbook` captures a `priArr()` array during its main pass, creates the Analytics sheet, calls `Analytics.BuildAnalyticsSheet`, and creates Chart 1 + Chart 2 after all sheet content exists. |
33	| `Analytics.bas` (new) | New `SHEET_ANALYTICS` sheet: Point-of-Care ward gap block + Chart 3, day-of-week block + Chart 4, EM turnaround block + Chart 5, EL lead-time block + Chart 6. |
34	| `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` | Mirror every change above; module order becomes Helpers, ChartHelpers, FilterFileA, FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, Analytics, BuildOutput, MainMacro, FilePickerForm, ProgressForm. |
35	| `docs/FC_Completion_Report_User_Guide.md` | Section 5.1 (new sheet order, headline block, charts) and Section 6 (balance row now at the bottom) updated. Sheet table in Section 5 gains "Analytics". |
36	| `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md` | New "Chart infrastructure" entry documenting the two new modules, the reorder, and manual-verification status. |
37	
38	---
39	
40	### Task 1: Fix CLAUDE.md's File A column reference
41

43	- Modify: `CLAUDE.md` (the "Key columns" bullet under "File A -- FC Summary Report")
44	
45	**Interfaces:** None (documentation only).
46	
47	- [ ] **Step 1: Replace the column reference bullet**
48	
49	Find this block in `CLAUDE.md`:
50

52	    AS: 1st CCF Creation User, AV: 1st CCF ETBS, AW: Latest CCF Creation
53	    User, AY: Latest CCF ETBS.
54	```
55

60	    CCF ETBS, AW: Latest CCF Creation User, **AX: Latest CCF Creation
61	    Date-Time**, AY: Latest CCF LOS, AZ: Latest CCF ETBS. **ETBS columns
62	    (AV, AZ) are currency (Estimated Total Bill Size, dollars) -- NOT

64	    ETBS" with the actual timestamp column; the real timestamp columns are
65	    AT and AX. Turnaround/lead-time calculations (Analytics sheet) use AT
66	    and AX exclusively, resolved by header text via `FindColByHeader`,
67	    never by letter.
68	```
69	
70	- [ ] **Step 2: Verify**

90	```vb
91	' Parses an eFC-format timestamp string "M/D/Y H:MM:SS AM/PM" into a Date
92	' value carrying both date and time-of-day (VBA Date is a Double: integer
93	' part = date, fractional part = time). Time part is optional -- if absent,
94	' the result carries a time of midnight. Returns False on blank/malformed
95	' text or an out-of-range month/day (same M/D/Y convention bug class as
96	' BuildOutput.TryParseMDYDate -- see that function's history comment).
97	Public Function TryParseMDYDateTime(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
98	    Dim txt As String
99	    txt = Trim(dateText)
100	    If txt = "" Then
101	        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
102	        Exit Function
103	    End If
104	
105	    Dim spacePos As Long
106	    spacePos = InStr(txt, " ")
107	    Dim datePart As String, timePart As String
108	    If spacePos > 0 Then
109	        datePart = Left(txt, spacePos - 1)
110	        timePart = Trim(Mid(txt, spacePos + 1))
111	    Else
112	        datePart = txt
113	        timePart = ""
114	    End If
115	
116	    Dim dparts() As String
117	    dparts = Split(datePart, "/")
118	    If UBound(dparts) <> 2 Then
119	        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
120	        Exit Function
121	    End If
122	    If Not IsNumeric(dparts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(2)) Then
123	        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
124	        Exit Function
125	    End If
126	
127	    Dim m As Long, dd As Long, y As Long
128	    m = CLng(dparts(0)): dd = CLng(dparts(1)): y = CLng(dparts(2))
129	    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
130	    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then
131	        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
132	        Exit Function
133	    End If
134	
135	    Dim baseDate As Date
136	    On Error GoTo Fail
137	    baseDate = DateSerial(y, m, dd)
138	
139	    Dim timeFraction As Double
140	    timeFraction = 0
141	    If timePart <> "" Then
142	        Dim ampm As String
143	        Dim tparts() As String
144	        Dim hh As Long, mi As Long, ss As Long
145	        Dim ampmPos As Long
146	        Dim workingTime As String
147	        workingTime = timePart
148	
149	        ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "AM", vbTextCompare)
150	        If ampmPos = 0 Then ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "PM", vbTextCompare)
151	        If ampmPos > 0 Then
152	            ampm = UCase(Mid(workingTime, ampmPos, 2))
153	            workingTime = Trim(Left(workingTime, ampmPos - 1))
154	        Else
155	            ampm = ""
156	        End If
157	
158	        tparts = Split(workingTime, ":")
159	        If UBound(tparts) >= 1 Then
160	            If IsNumeric(tparts(0)) Then hh = CLng(tparts(0)) Else hh = 0
161	            If IsNumeric(tparts(1)) Then mi = CLng(tparts(1)) Else mi = 0
162	            If UBound(tparts) >= 2 Then
163	                If IsNumeric(tparts(2)) Then ss = CLng(tparts(2)) Else ss = 0
164	            Else
165	                ss = 0
166	            End If
167	
168	            If ampm = "PM" And hh < 12 Then hh = hh + 12
169	            If ampm = "AM" And hh = 12 Then hh = 0
170	
171	            timeFraction = (hh * 3600 + mi * 60 + ss) / 86400
172	        End If
173	    End If
174	
175	    result = CDate(CDbl(baseDate) + timeFraction)
176	    TryParseMDYDateTime = True
177	    Exit Function
178	Fail:
179	    TryParseMDYDateTime = False
180	End Function
181	```

# Summary Restructure + Native Charts Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Reorder the FC Completion Report's Summary sheet so the status breakdown leads, add a headline block, and add six native Excel charts (two on Summary, four on a new Analytics sheet) driven by a hidden ChartData sheet.

**Architecture:** All chart source data is written to a new very-hidden `ChartData` sheet as contiguous blocks, copied from the same variables that already populate the visible tables (never recomputed). A single reusable `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock` helper (guarded with `On Error`) builds every chart so one chart failure never aborts report generation. Band fill colours are extracted into shared `ChartHelpers` constants so a table cell and its chart segment can never disagree. A new `Analytics.bas` module owns a new "Analytics" sheet (Point-of-Care ward gap, day-of-week, EM turnaround, EL lead-time blocks) and its four charts; `BuildOutput.bas` keeps owning the Summary sheet and its two charts.

**Tech Stack:** Excel VBA (no build system, no test runner -- verification is `grep` for structural integrity plus a user compile/run pass in Excel).

## Global Constraints

- Every change goes into BOTH the relevant `*.bas` file AND `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (clean ASCII, `--` for dashes, no smart quotes).
- `Option Explicit` in every module; resolve columns via `FindColByHeader`/`FindEncounterCol`, never hardcoded letters.
- VBA has no short-circuit evaluation -- never `IIf()` an array index; use explicit `If` guards.
- No 3D charts, no gradients, no shadows -- flat fills only.
- Every chart-creation path is wrapped in `On Error` so a charting failure skips that chart (with a note left on the sheet) and never aborts report generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation.
- Band colours (used by both the Summary table fills and every band-coloured chart) live in ONE place: `ChartHelpers.bas` constants.
  - Green `RGB(146,208,80)`, Pink `RGB(255,199,206)`, Light Green `RGB(198,239,206)`, Orange `RGB(255,192,0)`, Draft only `RGB(242,242,242)`, Voided only `RGB(217,217,217)`, Missed FC `RGB(166,166,166)`.
- Chart data columns/timestamps: `1st CCF Creation Date-Time` and `Latest CCF Creation Date-Time` are resolved by header text (`FindColByHeader`), never by letter. `1st CCF ETBS` / `Latest CCF ETBS` are currency (dollar amounts) and must never be used as timestamps.
- After every task: verify `grep -c "^Sub \|^Public Sub \|^Private Sub "` count matches `grep -c "^End Sub"` (same for `Function`/`End Function`) in every touched `.bas` file and in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt`.

Returns `False` on blank/malformed input or an out-of-range month/day, leaving `result` untouched. Consumed by `Analytics.bas` (Task 7) for turnaround and lead-time calculations.

- [ ] **Step 1: Append the function to `Helpers.bas`**

```vb
' Parses an eFC-format timestamp string "M/D/Y H:MM:SS AM/PM" into a Date
' value carrying both date and time-of-day (VBA Date is a Double: integer
' part = date, fractional part = time). Time part is optional -- if absent,
' the result carries a time of midnight. Returns False on blank/malformed
' text or an out-of-range month/day (same M/D/Y convention bug class as
' BuildOutput.TryParseMDYDate -- see that function's history comment).
Public Function TryParseMDYDateTime(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim txt As String
    txt = Trim(dateText)
    If txt = "" Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(txt, " ")
    Dim datePart As String, timePart As String
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Left(txt, spacePos - 1)
        timePart = Trim(Mid(txt, spacePos + 1))
    Else
        datePart = txt
        timePart = ""
    End If

    Dim dparts() As String
    dparts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(dparts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(dparts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(dparts(2)) Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim m As Long, dd As Long, y As Long
    m = CLng(dparts(0)): dd = CLng(dparts(1)): y = CLng(dparts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or dd < 1 Or dd > 31 Then
        TryParseMDYDateTime = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim baseDate As Date
    On Error GoTo Fail
    baseDate = DateSerial(y, m, dd)

    Dim timeFraction As Double
    timeFraction = 0
    If timePart <> "" Then
        Dim ampm As String
        Dim tparts() As String
        Dim hh As Long, mi As Long, ss As Long
        Dim ampmPos As Long
        Dim workingTime As String
        workingTime = timePart

        ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "AM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos = 0 Then ampmPos = InStr(1, workingTime, "PM", vbTextCompare)
        If ampmPos > 0 Then
            ampm = UCase(Mid(workingTime, ampmPos, 2))
            workingTime = Trim(Left(workingTime, ampmPos - 1))
        Else
            ampm = ""
        End If

        tparts = Split(workingTime, ":")
        If UBound(tparts) >= 1 Then
            If IsNumeric(tparts(0)) Then hh = CLng(tparts(0)) Else hh = 0
            If IsNumeric(tparts(1)) Then mi = CLng(tparts(1)) Else mi = 0
            If UBound(tparts) >= 2 Then
                If IsNumeric(tparts(2)) Then ss = CLng(tparts(2)) Else ss = 0
            Else
                ss = 0
            End If

            If ampm = "PM" And hh < 12 Then hh = hh + 12
            If ampm = "AM" And hh = 12 Then hh = 0

            timeFraction = (hh * 3600 + mi * 60 + ss) / 86400
        End If
    End If

    result = CDate(CDbl(baseDate) + timeFraction)
    TryParseMDYDateTime = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseMDYDateTime = False
End Function
```

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartHelpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' ChartHelpers.bas
'
' Shared native-chart infrastructure for the FC Completion Report:
'   - Band colour constants (used by BOTH the Summary table fills and every
'     band-coloured chart, so a table cell and its chart segment can never
'     disagree)
'   - EnsureChartDataSheet -- the single very-hidden sheet every chart's
'     source range lives on (contiguous blocks only -- non-contiguous
'     SetSourceData ranges are the main source of VBA charting failures)
'   - AddChartFromBlock -- one reusable chart-creation helper, guarded with
'     On Error so a charting failure skips that chart (never aborts report
'     generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation)
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_CHARTDATA As String = "ChartData"

' Seven completion-status band colours -- must match WriteSummaryBlock's
' table fills exactly (BuildOutput.bas) so a coloured table cell and its
' chart segment never disagree.
Public Const BAND_COLOR_GREEN As Long = 5287310      ' RGB(146,208,80)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_PINK As Long = 13556223       ' RGB(255,199,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN As Long = 13561542    ' RGB(198,239,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_ORANGE As Long = 49152        ' RGB(255,192,0)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_DRAFT As Long = 15921906      ' RGB(242,242,242)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_VOIDED As Long = 14277081     ' RGB(217,217,217)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_MISSED As Long = 10921638     ' RGB(166,166,166)

' Finds the very-hidden ChartData sheet, creating it (as the last sheet in
' the workbook) if it does not yet exist. Safe to call multiple times per
' report run -- every chart-writing routine calls this before writing its
' block.
Public Function EnsureChartDataSheet(wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(SHEET_CHARTDATA)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        ws.Name = SHEET_CHARTDATA
    End If

    ws.Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    Set EnsureChartDataSheet = ws
End Function

' Creates one chart anchored at anchorCell's top-left corner, sized
' widthPts x heightPts, sourced from srcRange (expected to be a contiguous
' block on the ChartData sheet). seriesColours is a 0-based Variant array of
' RGB Longs (one per series, in SeriesCollection order); pass Empty entries
' to skip colouring a given series (e.g. when a chart type applies its own
' per-point colouring instead). Returns Nothing if anything fails -- callers
' MUST check for Nothing and skip gracefully; a charting failure must never
' abort report generation.
Public Function AddChartFromBlock(targetWs As Worksheet, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
        chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
        widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
        seriesColours As Variant, chartName As String) As ChartObject

    On Error GoTo Fail

    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = targetWs.ChartObjects.Add(anchorCell.Left, anchorCell.Top, widthPts, heightPts)
    co.Name = chartName

    With co.Chart
        .SetSourceData Source:=srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
        .ChartType = chartType
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = titleText

        If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours) Then
            Dim k As Long
            For k = LBound(seriesColours) To UBound(seriesColours)
                If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours(k)) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .SeriesCollection(k - LBound(seriesColours) + 1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = CLng(seriesColours(k))
                    On Error GoTo Fail
                End If
            Next k
        End If

        If .SeriesCollection.Count > 1 Then
            .HasLegend = True
            .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        Else
            .HasLegend = False
        End If

        .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    End With

    Set AddChartFromBlock = co
    Exit Function

Fail:
    Set AddChartFromBlock = Nothing
End Function
```

```vb
' ---- Headline block (new) -------------------------------------------------

' Three rows -- EM / EL / Combined -- each showing denominator, "completed"
' count, and "completed" %. "Completed" here mirrors the existing
' "Not completed (total)" complement already used throughout this sheet:
' Green + Pink + Light Green (i.e. denominator minus Orange/Draft/Voided/
' Missed). This is the single number the department meeting comes for, so
' it must be visible without scrolling -- bold, 14pt for the percentage.
Private Sub WriteHeadlineBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, _
        elEnc As Long, missedEL As Long, elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "HEADLINE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Category"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Denominator"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 4)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim emDenom As Long, elDenom As Long, combDenom As Long
    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long
    emDenom = emEnc + missedEM
    elDenom = elEnc + missedEL
    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen
    elCompleted = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen
    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Emergency (EM)", emDenom, emCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Elective Inpatient (EL)", elDenom, elCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteHeadlineRow(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, label As String, denom As Long, completed As Long)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = label
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = completed
    If denom > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = completed / denom
        ws.Cells(r, 4).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = ""
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 1
End Sub
```

' ---- Chart 1 (status mix) + Chart 2 (band counts EM vs EL) ---------------

' Writes both charts' ChartData blocks and creates the charts. Guarded per-
' chart with On Error inside AddChartFromBlock -- a failure on one chart
' never blocks the other or aborts report generation.
Private Sub BuildSummaryCharts(outWb As Workbook, wsSummary As Worksheet, _
        chart1AnchorRow As Long, chart2AnchorRow As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long)

    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)

    ' ---- Chart 1 block: ChartData!A1:H4 (rows = EM/EL/Combined, cols = 7 bands) ----
    cd.Cells(1, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(1, 2).Value = "Green": cd.Cells(1, 3).Value = "Pink": cd.Cells(1, 4).Value = "Light Green"
    cd.Cells(1, 5).Value = "Orange": cd.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Draft only": cd.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Voided only"
    cd.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Missed FC"

    cd.Cells(2, 1).Value = "EM"
    cd.Cells(2, 2).Value = emGreen: cd.Cells(2, 3).Value = emPink: cd.Cells(2, 4).Value = emLtGreen
    cd.Cells(2, 5).Value = emOrange: cd.Cells(2, 6).Value = emDraft: cd.Cells(2, 7).Value = emVoided
    cd.Cells(2, 8).Value = missedEM

    cd.Cells(3, 1).Value = "EL"
    cd.Cells(3, 2).Value = elGreen: cd.Cells(3, 3).Value = elPink: cd.Cells(3, 4).Value = elLtGreen
    cd.Cells(3, 5).Value = elOrange: cd.Cells(3, 6).Value = elDraft: cd.Cells(3, 7).Value = elVoided
    cd.Cells(3, 8).Value = missedEL

    cd.Cells(4, 1).Value = "Combined"
    cd.Cells(4, 2).Value = emGreen + elGreen: cd.Cells(4, 3).Value = emPink + elPink
    cd.Cells(4, 4).Value = emLtGreen + elLtGreen: cd.Cells(4, 5).Value = emOrange + elOrange
    cd.Cells(4, 6).Value = emDraft + elDraft: cd.Cells(4, 7).Value = emVoided + elVoided
    cd.Cells(4, 8).Value = missedEM + missedEL

    Dim chart1Colours As Variant
    chart1Colours = Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN, BAND_COLOR_PINK, BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN, BAND_COLOR_ORANGE, _
        BAND_COLOR_DRAFT, BAND_COLOR_VOIDED, BAND_COLOR_MISSED)

    Dim co1 As ChartObject
    Set co1 = AddChartFromBlock(wsSummary, wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(1, 1), cd.Cells(4, 8)), xlColumnStacked100, _
        "Status Mix -- EM / EL / Combined", 420, 260, chart1Colours, "chtStatusMix")

    If Not co1 Is Nothing Then
        ' Data labels showing percentage on the Green segment only (the
        ' others clutter it) -- computed manually since 100%-stacked column
        ' charts do not expose a built-in "show percentage" label type.
        On Error Resume Next
        Dim greenTotals(1 To 3) As Long, rowTotals(1 To 3) As Long
        greenTotals(1) = emGreen: greenTotals(2) = elGreen: greenTotals(3) = emGreen + elGreen
        rowTotals(1) = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen + emOrange + emDraft + emVoided + missedEM
        rowTotals(2) = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen + elOrange + elDraft + elVoided + missedEL
        rowTotals(3) = rowTotals(1) + rowTotals(2)

        Dim pIdx As Long
        For pIdx = 1 To 3
            With co1.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Points(pIdx)
                .HasDataLabel = True
                If rowTotals(pIdx) > 0 Then
                    .DataLabel.Text = Format(greenTotals(pIdx) / rowTotals(pIdx), "0%")
                End If
            End With
        Next pIdx
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1).Value = "(Chart 1 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If

    ' ---- Chart 2 block: ChartData!A8:C16 (rows = 7 bands, cols = EM/EL) ----
    cd.Cells(8, 1).Value = "": cd.Cells(8, 2).Value = "EM": cd.Cells(8, 3).Value = "EL"
    cd.Cells(9, 1).Value = "Green": cd.Cells(9, 2).Value = emGreen: cd.Cells(9, 3).Value = elGreen
    cd.Cells(10, 1).Value = "Pink": cd.Cells(10, 2).Value = emPink: cd.Cells(10, 3).Value = elPink
    cd.Cells(11, 1).Value = "Light Green": cd.Cells(11, 2).Value = emLtGreen: cd.Cells(11, 3).Value = elLtGreen
    cd.Cells(12, 1).Value = "Orange": cd.Cells(12, 2).Value = emOrange: cd.Cells(12, 3).Value = elOrange
    cd.Cells(13, 1).Value = "Draft only": cd.Cells(13, 2).Value = emDraft: cd.Cells(13, 3).Value = elDraft
    cd.Cells(14, 1).Value = "Voided only": cd.Cells(14, 2).Value = emVoided: cd.Cells(14, 3).Value = elVoided
    cd.Cells(15, 1).Value = "Missed FC": cd.Cells(15, 2).Value = missedEM: cd.Cells(15, 3).Value = missedEL

    Dim chart2Colours As Variant
    chart2Colours = Array(RGB(31, 73, 125), RGB(128, 128, 128))

    Dim co2 As ChartObject
    Set co2 = AddChartFromBlock(wsSummary, wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(8, 1), cd.Cells(15, 3)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "Band Counts -- EM vs EL", 420, 260, chart2Colours, "chtBandCounts")

    If co2 Is Nothing Then
        wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1).Value = "(Chart 2 could not be created -- see tables above.)"
        wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
End Sub

```vb
Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Analytics.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
' table can never drift apart.
'
'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
'

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartHelpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' ChartHelpers.bas
'
' Shared native-chart infrastructure for the FC Completion Report:
'   - Band colour constants (used by BOTH the Summary table fills and every
'     band-coloured chart, so a table cell and its chart segment can never
'     disagree)
'   - EnsureChartDataSheet -- the single very-hidden sheet every chart's
'     source range lives on (contiguous blocks only -- non-contiguous
'     SetSourceData ranges are the main source of VBA charting failures)
'   - AddChartFromBlock -- one reusable chart-creation helper, guarded with
'     On Error so a charting failure skips that chart (never aborts report
'     generation -- the tables are the deliverable, charts are presentation)
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_CHARTDATA As String = "ChartData"

' Seven completion-status band colours -- must match WriteSummaryBlock's
' table fills exactly (BuildOutput.bas) so a coloured table cell and its
' chart segment never disagree.
Public Const BAND_COLOR_GREEN As Long = 5296274      ' RGB(146,208,80)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_PINK As Long = 13551615       ' RGB(255,199,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN As Long = 13561798    ' RGB(198,239,206)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_ORANGE As Long = 49407        ' RGB(255,192,0)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_DRAFT As Long = 15921906      ' RGB(242,242,242)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_VOIDED As Long = 14277081     ' RGB(217,217,217)
Public Const BAND_COLOR_MISSED As Long = 10921638     ' RGB(166,166,166)

' Finds the very-hidden ChartData sheet, creating it (as the last sheet in
' the workbook) if it does not yet exist. Safe to call multiple times per
' report run -- every chart-writing routine calls this before writing its
' block.
Public Function EnsureChartDataSheet(wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(SHEET_CHARTDATA)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        ws.Name = SHEET_CHARTDATA
    End If

    ws.Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    Set EnsureChartDataSheet = ws
End Function

' Creates one chart anchored at anchorCell's top-left corner, sized
' widthPts x heightPts, sourced from srcRange (expected to be a contiguous
' block on the ChartData sheet). seriesColours is a 0-based Variant array of
' RGB Longs (one per series, in SeriesCollection order); pass Empty entries
' to skip colouring a given series (e.g. when a chart type applies its own
' per-point colouring instead). Returns Nothing if anything fails -- callers
' MUST check for Nothing and skip gracefully; a charting failure must never
' abort report generation.
Public Function AddChartFromBlock(targetWs As Worksheet, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
        chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
        widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
        seriesColours As Variant, chartName As String) As ChartObject

    On Error GoTo Fail

    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = targetWs.ChartObjects.Add(anchorCell.Left, anchorCell.Top, widthPts, heightPts)
    co.Name = chartName

    With co.Chart
        .SetSourceData Source:=srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
        .ChartType = chartType
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = titleText

        If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours) Then
            Dim k As Long
            For k = LBound(seriesColours) To UBound(seriesColours)
                If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours(k)) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .SeriesCollection(k - LBound(seriesColours) + 1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = CLng(seriesColours(k))
                    On Error GoTo Fail
                End If
            Next k
        End If

        If .SeriesCollection.Count > 1 Then
            .HasLegend = True
            .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        Else
            .HasLegend = False
        End If

        .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    End With

    Set AddChartFromBlock = co
    Exit Function

Fail:
    Set AddChartFromBlock = Nothing
End Function

1	Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' Analytics.bas
6	'
7	' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
8	' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
9	' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
10	' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
11	' table can never drift apart.
12	'
13	'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
14	'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
15	'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
16	'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
17	'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
18	'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
19	'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
20	'
21	' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
22	' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
23	' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
24	' ============================================================
25	
26	Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"
27	
28	' NOT-DONE = Orange (6) + Draft (98) + Voided (99) -- same three bands that
29	' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
30	' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
31	Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
32	    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
33	End Function
34	
35	' Green band = priority 1-2 ("completed"), same definition used by the
36	' Summary sheet's headline block (WriteHeadlineBlock, BuildOutput.bas).
37	Private Function IsGreenPriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
38	    IsGreenPriority = (pri <= 2)
39	End Function
40	
41	' Sorts a Double array in place (ascending) via manual insertion sort --
42	' VBA has no built-in sort. Bounded by monthly encounter volume (a few
43	' thousand rows at most), same complexity trade-off already accepted by
44	' Helpers.SortDictKeysDescending for the same reason.
45	Private Sub SortDoubleArray(vals() As Double, n As Long)
46	    Dim i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
47	    For i = 2 To n
48	        tmp = vals(i)
49	        j = i - 1
50	        Do While j >= 1
51	            If vals(j) <= tmp Then Exit Do
52	            vals(j + 1) = vals(j)
53	            j = j - 1
54	        Loop
55	        vals(j + 1) = tmp
56	    Next i
57	End Sub
58	
59	Private Function MedianOfArray(vals() As Double, n As Long) As Double
60	    If n = 0 Then
61	        MedianOfArray = 0
62	        Exit Function
63	    End If
64	    SortDoubleArray vals, n
65	    If n Mod 2 = 1 Then
66	        MedianOfArray = vals((n + 1) \ 2)
67	    Else
68	        MedianOfArray = (vals(n \ 2) + vals(n \ 2 + 1)) / 2
69	    End If
70	End Function
71	
72	Private Function HoursBetween(startDt As Date, endDt As Date) As Double
73	    HoursBetween = (endDt - startDt) * 24
74	End Function
75	
76	' 1 = <=24h, 2 = 24-48h, 3 = 48-72h, 4 = >72h
77	Private Function TurnaroundBucket(hrs As Double) As Long
78	    If hrs <= 24 Then
79	        TurnaroundBucket = 1
80	    ElseIf hrs <= 48 Then
81	        TurnaroundBucket = 2
82	    ElseIf hrs <= 72 Then
83	        TurnaroundBucket = 3
84	    Else
85	        TurnaroundBucket = 4
86	    End If
87	End Function
88	
89	' 1 = 14+ days, 2 = 7-14 days, 3 = 1-7 days, 4 = same day or after.
90	' leadDays = whole days from 1st CCF Creation Date-Time to Admission Date
91	' (Admission Date's DateValue minus the CCF's DateValue) -- positive means
92	' the CCF was created ahead of admission.
93	Private Function LeadDayBucket(leadDays As Long) As Long
94	    If leadDays >= 14 Then
95	        LeadDayBucket = 1
96	    ElseIf leadDays >= 7 Then
97	        LeadDayBucket = 2
98	    ElseIf leadDays >= 1 Then
99	        LeadDayBucket = 3
100	    Else
101	        LeadDayBucket = 4
102	    End If
103	End Function
104	
105	' ---- Block 1: Point of Care ward gap (Chart 3) ----------------------------
106	
107	' EM+EL combined (secArr(i) > 0) grouped by Point of Care text. Returns the
108	' full set via wardTotal/wardNotDone dictionaries so the caller can both
109	' write the visible table and feed the same numbers into the chart.
110	Private Sub ComputeWardBreakdown(fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
111	        pocCol As Long, wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object)
112	    wardTotal.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

Attribute VB_Name = "Analytics"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Analytics.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report's "Analytics" sheet: four blocks, each
' with a native chart, each sourced from a contiguous block on the shared
' ChartData sheet (see ChartHelpers.bas) copied from the SAME variables
' used to write the visible table -- never recomputed, so a chart and its
' table can never drift apart.
'
'   1. Point of Care ward gap -- top 10 wards by NOT-DONE count (Chart 3)
'   2. Day of week -- EM completion rate, Mon-Sun (Chart 4)
'   3. EM turnaround -- Admission Date -> 1st CCF Creation Date-Time,
'      bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h (Chart 5)
'   4. EL lead time -- Admission Date minus 1st CCF Creation Date-Time in
'      days, bucketed 14+/7-14/1-7/same-day-or-after/no-CCF-created,
'      vs. completion rate (Chart 6)
'
' All four charts are guarded with On Error inside
' ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock -- a charting failure skips that chart and
' leaves a note on the sheet; it never aborts report generation.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_ANALYTICS As String = "Analytics"

' NOT-DONE = Orange (6) + Draft (98) + Voided (99) -- same three bands that
' make up "Not completed (total)" on the Summary sheet, minus Missed FC
' (which has no Point of Care value to attribute to a ward).
Private Function IsNotDonePriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsNotDonePriority = (pri = 6 Or pri = 98 Or pri = 99)
End Function

' Green band = priority 1-2 ("completed"), same definition used by the
' Summary sheet's headline block (WriteHeadlineBlock, BuildOutput.bas).
Private Function IsGreenPriority(pri As Long) As Boolean
    IsGreenPriority = (pri <= 2)
End Function

' Sorts a Double array in place (ascending) via manual insertion sort --
' VBA has no built-in sort. Bounded by monthly encounter volume (a few
' thousand rows at most), same complexity trade-off already accepted by
' Helpers.SortDictKeysDescending for the same reason.
Private Sub SortDoubleArray(vals() As Double, n As Long)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
    For i = 2 To n
        tmp = vals(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 1
            If vals(j) <= tmp Then Exit Do
            vals(j + 1) = vals(j)
            j = j - 1
        Loop
        vals(j + 1) = tmp
    Next i
End Sub

Private Function MedianOfArray(vals() As Double, n As Long) As Double
    If n = 0 Then
        MedianOfArray = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    SortDoubleArray vals, n
    If n Mod 2 = 1 Then
        MedianOfArray = vals((n + 1) \ 2)
    Else
        MedianOfArray = (vals(n \ 2) + vals(n \ 2 + 1)) / 2
    End If
End Function

Private Function HoursBetween(startDt As Date, endDt As Date) As Double
    HoursBetween = (endDt - startDt) * 24
End Function

' 1 = <=24h, 2 = 24-48h, 3 = 48-72h, 4 = >72h
Private Function TurnaroundBucket(hrs As Double) As Long
    If hrs <= 24 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 1
    ElseIf hrs <= 48 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 2
    ElseIf hrs <= 72 Then
        TurnaroundBucket = 3
    Else
        TurnaroundBucket = 4
    End If
End Function

' 1 = 14+ days, 2 = 7-14 days, 3 = 1-7 days, 4 = same day or after.
' leadDays = whole days from 1st CCF Creation Date-Time to Admission Date
' (Admission Date's DateValue minus the CCF's DateValue) -- positive means
' the CCF was created ahead of admission.
Private Function LeadDayBucket(leadDays As Long) As Long
    If leadDays >= 14 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 1
    ElseIf leadDays >= 7 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 2
    ElseIf leadDays >= 1 Then
        LeadDayBucket = 3
    Else
        LeadDayBucket = 4
    End If
End Function

' ---- Block 1: Point of Care ward gap (Chart 3) ----------------------------

' EM+EL combined (secArr(i) > 0) grouped by Point of Care text. Returns the
' full set via wardTotal/wardNotDone dictionaries so the caller can both
' write the visible table and feed the same numbers into the chart.
Private Sub ComputeWardBreakdown(fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
        pocCol As Long, wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object)
    wardTotal.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    wardNotDone.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    If pocCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim i As Long, ward As String
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) > 0 Then
            ward = Trim(CStr(fullData(i, pocCol)))
            If ward <> "" Then
                If Not wardTotal.Exists(ward) Then
                    wardTotal(ward) = 0
                    wardNotDone(ward) = 0
                End If
                wardTotal(ward) = wardTotal(ward) + 1
                If IsNotDonePriority(priArr(i)) Then
                    wardNotDone(ward) = wardNotDone(ward) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub WriteWardGapBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, pocCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "WHERE THE GAP IS -- POINT OF CARE (EM + EL COMBINED)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If pocCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Point of Care column not found in File A -- this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim wardTotal As Object, wardNotDone As Object
    Set wardTotal = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set wardNotDone = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    ComputeWardBreakdown fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, pocCol, wardTotal, wardNotDone

    If wardTotal.Count = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(No Point of Care data found.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim sortedWards As Variant
    sortedWards = SortDictKeysDescending(wardNotDone)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Point of Care"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Not Done"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Total"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim topN As Long
    topN = UBound(sortedWards) - LBound(sortedWards) + 1
    If topN > 10 Then topN = 10

    Dim chartWards(1 To 10) As String
    Dim chartNotDone(1 To 10) As Long
    Dim wi As Long, ward As String
    For wi = 1 To topN
        ward = CStr(sortedWards(LBound(sortedWards) + wi - 1))
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ward
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = wardNotDone(ward)
        ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = wardTotal(ward)
        chartWards(wi) = ward
        chartNotDone(wi) = wardNotDone(ward)
        r = r + 1
    Next wi
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 20-29, cols A:B (largest NOT-DONE last, so
    ' ReversePlotOrder puts it at the TOP of the horizontal bar chart) ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    Dim ci As Long
    For ci = 1 To topN
        cd.Cells(19 + ci, 1).Value = chartWards(topN - ci + 1)
        cd.Cells(19 + ci, 2).Value = chartNotDone(topN - ci + 1)
    Next ci
    cd.Cells(19, 1).Value = "Ward"
    cd.Cells(19, 2).Value = "Not Done"

    Dim co3 As ChartObject
    Set co3 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(19, 1), cd.Cells(19 + topN, 2)), xlBarClustered, _
        "Where the Gap Is -- Top " & topN & " Wards by Not-Done Count", 420, 260, _
        Array(BAND_COLOR_ORANGE), "chtWardGap")

    If Not co3 Is Nothing Then
        On Error Resume Next
        co3.Chart.HasLegend = False
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 3 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub

' ---- Block 2: Day of week -- EM completion rate (Chart 4) -----------------

Private Sub WriteDayOfWeekBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, admDateCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EM COMPLETION RATE BY DAY OF WEEK (ADMISSION DATE)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If admDateCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Admission Date column not found -- this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim dayTotal(1 To 7) As Long, dayGreen(1 To 7) As Long
    Dim overallGreen As Long, overallTotal As Long

    Dim i As Long, admText As String, admDt As Date, wd As Long
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 1 Then   ' SEC_EM
            admText = CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol))
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(admText, admDt) Then
                wd = Weekday(admDt, vbMonday)   ' 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday
                dayTotal(wd) = dayTotal(wd) + 1
                overallTotal = overallTotal + 1
                If IsGreenPriority(priArr(i)) Then
                    dayGreen(wd) = dayGreen(wd) + 1
                    overallGreen = overallGreen + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    Dim dayNames(1 To 7) As String
    dayNames(1) = "Monday": dayNames(2) = "Tuesday": dayNames(3) = "Wednesday"
    dayNames(4) = "Thursday": dayNames(5) = "Friday": dayNames(6) = "Saturday": dayNames(7) = "Sunday"

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Day"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "EM Encounters"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim dPct(1 To 7) As Double
    Dim d As Long
    For d = 1 To 7
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = dayNames(d)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = dayTotal(d)
        If dayTotal(d) > 0 Then
            dPct(d) = dayGreen(d) / dayTotal(d)
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = dPct(d)
            ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        Else
            dPct(d) = 0
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next d

    Dim overallPct As Double
    If overallTotal > 0 Then overallPct = overallGreen / overallTotal Else overallPct = 0
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Overall EM completion rate (reference line on chart)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = overallPct
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 33-41, cols A:C ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(33, 1).Value = "": cd.Cells(33, 2).Value = "Completed %": cd.Cells(33, 3).Value = "Overall"
    For d = 1 To 7
        cd.Cells(33 + d, 1).Value = dayNames(d)
        cd.Cells(33 + d, 2).Value = dPct(d)
        cd.Cells(33 + d, 3).Value = overallPct
    Next d

    Dim co4 As ChartObject
    Set co4 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(33, 1), cd.Cells(40, 3)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "EM Completion Rate by Day of Week", 420, 260, _
        Array(RGB(0, 128, 0), Empty), "chtDayOfWeek")

    If Not co4 Is Nothing Then
        On Error Resume Next
        co4.Chart.SeriesCollection(2).ChartType = xlLine
        co4.Chart.SeriesCollection(2).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        co4.Chart.Axes(xlValue).TickLabels.NumberFormat = "0%"
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 4 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub

' ---- Block 3: EM turnaround distribution (Chart 5) -------------------------

Private Sub WriteEMTurnaroundBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, admDateCol As Long, _
        firstCCFDtCol As Long, latestCCFDtCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EM TURNAROUND -- ADMISSION TO 1ST CCF CREATION"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If admDateCol = 0 Or firstCCFDtCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Admission Date or '1st CCF Creation Date-Time' column not found -- " & _
            "this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim bucketCt(1 To 4) As Long
    Dim excludedCt As Long, includedCt As Long
    Dim firstHours() As Double, latestHours() As Double
    ReDim firstHours(1 To aLastRow)
    ReDim latestHours(1 To aLastRow)
    Dim firstN As Long, latestN As Long

    Dim i As Long, admDt As Date, firstDt As Date, latestDt As Date, hrs As Double
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 1 Then   ' SEC_EM
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol)), admDt) Then
                If firstCCFDtCol > 0 And TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, firstCCFDtCol)), firstDt) Then
                    hrs = HoursBetween(admDt, firstDt)
                    If hrs < 0 Then hrs = 0
                    bucketCt(TurnaroundBucket(hrs)) = bucketCt(TurnaroundBucket(hrs)) + 1
                    includedCt = includedCt + 1
                    firstN = firstN + 1
                    firstHours(firstN) = hrs

                    If latestCCFDtCol > 0 And TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, latestCCFDtCol)), latestDt) Then
                        Dim latestHrs As Double
                        latestHrs = HoursBetween(admDt, latestDt)
                        If latestHrs < 0 Then latestHrs = 0
                        latestN = latestN + 1
                        latestHours(latestN) = latestHrs
                    End If
                Else
                    excludedCt = excludedCt + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    Dim medianFirst As Double, medianLatest As Double
    medianFirst = MedianOfArray(firstHours, firstN)
    medianLatest = MedianOfArray(latestHours, latestN)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Median hours, admission -> 1st CCF (responsiveness)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = Round(medianFirst, 1)
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Median hours, admission -> latest CCF (closure)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = Round(medianLatest, 1)
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Excluded -- no CCF ever generated (1st CCF Creation Date-Time blank)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = excludedCt
    r = r + 2

    Dim bucketLabels(1 To 4) As String
    bucketLabels(1) = "<=24h": bucketLabels(2) = "24-48h": bucketLabels(3) = "48-72h": bucketLabels(4) = ">72h"

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Turnaround"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim bPct(1 To 4) As Double
    Dim b As Long
    For b = 1 To 4
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = bucketLabels(b)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bucketCt(b)
        If includedCt > 0 Then
            bPct(b) = bucketCt(b) / includedCt
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = bPct(b)
            ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next b
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 48-53, cols A:B ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(48, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(48, 2).Value = "% of encounters with a CCF"
    For b = 1 To 4
        cd.Cells(48 + b, 1).Value = bucketLabels(b)
        cd.Cells(48 + b, 2).Value = bPct(b)
    Next b

    Dim chartTitle As String
    chartTitle = "EM Turnaround Distribution (excludes " & excludedCt & " with no CCF created)"

    Dim co5 As ChartObject
    Set co5 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(48, 1), cd.Cells(52, 2)), xlColumnClustered, _
        chartTitle, 420, 260, Array(RGB(31, 73, 125)), "chtEMTurnaround")

    If co5 Is Nothing Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 5 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 20
End Sub

' ---- Block 4: EL lead time vs completion (Chart 6) -------------------------

Private Sub WriteELLeadTimeBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
        admDateCol As Long, firstCCFDtCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL LEAD TIME VS. COMPLETION"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If admDateCol = 0 Or firstCCFDtCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Admission Date or '1st CCF Creation Date-Time' column not found -- " & _
            "this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Bucket order fixed (do not sort): 14+ days, 7-14 days, 1-7 days,
    ' Same day or after, No CCF created. Bucket 5 ("No CCF created") is
    ' every EL encounter with a blank 1st CCF Creation Date-Time -- it MUST
    ' appear as its own bar at 0% completion, never excluded (excluding it
    ' would hide a large share of elective admissions).
    Dim bucketN(1 To 5) As Long, bucketGreen(1 To 5) As Long
    Dim bucketLabels(1 To 5) As String
    bucketLabels(1) = "14+ days": bucketLabels(2) = "7-14 days": bucketLabels(3) = "1-7 days"
    bucketLabels(4) = "Same day or after": bucketLabels(5) = "No CCF created"

    Dim i As Long, admDt As Date, firstDt As Date, leadDays As Long, bkt As Long
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 2 Then   ' SEC_EL
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol)), admDt) Then
                If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, firstCCFDtCol)), firstDt) Then
                    leadDays = CLng(DateValue(admDt) - DateValue(firstDt))
                    bkt = LeadDayBucket(leadDays)
                Else
                    bkt = 5   ' No CCF created
                End If
                bucketN(bkt) = bucketN(bkt) + 1
                If bkt <> 5 Then
                    If IsGreenPriority(priArr(i)) Then bucketGreen(bkt) = bucketGreen(bkt) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Lead Time Bucket"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "n"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim bPct(1 To 5) As Double
    Dim smallN As Boolean
    Dim bk As Long
    For bk = 1 To 5
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bucketN(bk)
        smallN = (bucketN(bk) < 30)
        If bk = 5 Then
            bPct(bk) = 0
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 0
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        ElseIf bucketN(bk) > 0 Then
            bPct(bk) = bucketGreen(bk) / bucketN(bk)
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = bPct(bk)
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        End If
        If smallN Then
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = ""
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "n < 30 -- percentage suppressed"
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Italic = True
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next bk
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 57-63, cols A:B ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(57, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(57, 2).Value = "Completed %"
    For bk = 1 To 5
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk) & " (n=" & bucketN(bk) & ")"
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 2).Value = bPct(bk)
    Next bk

    Dim co6 As ChartObject
    Set co6 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(57, 1), cd.Cells(62, 2)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "EL Lead Time vs. Completion", 420, 260, Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN), "chtELLeadTime")

    If Not co6 Is Nothing Then
        r = r + 19
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective FCs completed further ahead of admission are markedly more " & _
            "likely to be closed. Lead time is measured to the FIRST CCF."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 6 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    End If
End Sub

' ---- Orchestrator ----------------------------------------------------------

Public Sub BuildAnalyticsSheet(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, _
        secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, pocCol As Long, admDateCol As Long, _
        firstCCFDtCol As Long, latestCCFDtCol As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Analytics"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    WriteWardGapBlock ws, outWb, r, fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, pocCol
    WriteDayOfWeekBlock ws, outWb, r, fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, admDateCol
    WriteEMTurnaroundBlock ws, outWb, r, fullData, aLastRow, secArr, admDateCol, firstCCFDtCol, latestCCFDtCol
    WriteELLeadTimeBlock ws, outWb, r, fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, admDateCol, firstCCFDtCol

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 45
    ws.Columns("B:D").ColumnWidth = 14
End Sub

' ---- Headline block (new) -------------------------------------------------

' Three rows -- EM / EL / Combined -- each showing denominator, "completed"
' count, and "completed" %. "Completed" here mirrors the existing
' "Not completed (total)" complement already used throughout this sheet:
' Green + Pink + Light Green (i.e. denominator minus Orange/Draft/Voided/
' Missed). This is the single number the department meeting comes for, so
' it must be visible without scrolling -- bold, 14pt for the percentage.
Private Sub WriteHeadlineBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, _
        elEnc As Long, missedEL As Long, elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "HEADLINE"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Category"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Denominator"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 4)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim emDenom As Long, elDenom As Long, combDenom As Long
    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long
    emDenom = emEnc + missedEM
    elDenom = elEnc + missedEL
    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen
    elCompleted = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen
    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Emergency (EM)", emDenom, emCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Elective Inpatient (EL)", elDenom, elCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteHeadlineRow(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, label As String, denom As Long, completed As Long)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = label
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = completed
    If denom > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = completed / denom
        ws.Cells(r, 4).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = ""
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, waterfall As Object, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long, ncidOrange As Long, _
        ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoided As Long, ncidTeams As Object, ncidBlankCCF As Long, _
        ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, unmatchedNCIDWards As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, _
        ByRef chart1AnchorRow As Long, ByRef chart2AnchorRow As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- HEADLINE BLOCK (new) ----
    WriteHeadlineBlock ws, r, emEnc, missedEM, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, _
        elEnc, missedEL, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen
    chart1AnchorRow = r
    r = r + 20   ' reserve space for Chart 1 (~420x260pt, well under 20 default-height rows)

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "STAFF ROSTER NOT MATCHED -- team attribution and all four " & _
            "numerator indicators are unavailable this run (the Config roster is empty or matched " & _
            "no names in this export). Completion statistics below are still valid."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 2
    End If

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, emVoided, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- EL block (Revert A, 2026-07-30: always computed -- Admission Type alone) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
        elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, elVoided, _
        elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- of which NCID wards (PART 3.1 sub-block under EL) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "  of which NCID wards (subset of EL)", _
        ncidEnc, 0, missedFCSourceLabel, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoided, _
        ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- Combined block ----
    Dim combTeams As Object
    Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts combTeams
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
        combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
    Next tk

    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
        emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, _
        emDraft + elDraft, emVoided + elVoided, _
        combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
        emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
        emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    chart2AnchorRow = r
    r = r + 20   ' reserve space for Chart 2

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted IN the denominator and IN " & _
        "'not completed', REVERT B 2026-07-30): " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If modeFilterExcludedEncounters > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s) excluded -- only form " & _
            "was a Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If

' Writes both charts' ChartData blocks and creates the charts. Guarded per-
' chart with On Error inside AddChartFromBlock -- a failure on one chart
' never blocks the other or aborts report generation.
Private Sub BuildSummaryCharts(outWb As Workbook, wsSummary As Worksheet, _
        chart1AnchorRow As Long, chart2AnchorRow As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long)

    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)

    ' ---- Chart 1 block: ChartData!A1:H4 (rows = EM/EL/Combined, cols = 7 bands) ----
    cd.Cells(1, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(1, 2).Value = "Green": cd.Cells(1, 3).Value = "Pink": cd.Cells(1, 4).Value = "Light Green"
    cd.Cells(1, 5).Value = "Orange": cd.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Draft only": cd.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Voided only"
    cd.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Missed FC"

    cd.Cells(2, 1).Value = "EM"
    cd.Cells(2, 2).Value = emGreen: cd.Cells(2, 3).Value = emPink: cd.Cells(2, 4).Value = emLtGreen
    cd.Cells(2, 5).Value = emOrange: cd.Cells(2, 6).Value = emDraft: cd.Cells(2, 7).Value = emVoided
    cd.Cells(2, 8).Value = missedEM

    cd.Cells(3, 1).Value = "EL"
    cd.Cells(3, 2).Value = elGreen: cd.Cells(3, 3).Value = elPink: cd.Cells(3, 4).Value = elLtGreen
    cd.Cells(3, 5).Value = elOrange: cd.Cells(3, 6).Value = elDraft: cd.Cells(3, 7).Value = elVoided
    cd.Cells(3, 8).Value = missedEL

    cd.Cells(4, 1).Value = "Combined"
    cd.Cells(4, 2).Value = emGreen + elGreen: cd.Cells(4, 3).Value = emPink + elPink
    cd.Cells(4, 4).Value = emLtGreen + elLtGreen: cd.Cells(4, 5).Value = emOrange + elOrange
    cd.Cells(4, 6).Value = emDraft + elDraft: cd.Cells(4, 7).Value = emVoided + elVoided
    cd.Cells(4, 8).Value = missedEM + missedEL

    Dim chart1Colours As Variant
    chart1Colours = Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN, BAND_COLOR_PINK, BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN, BAND_COLOR_ORANGE, _
        BAND_COLOR_DRAFT, BAND_COLOR_VOIDED, BAND_COLOR_MISSED)

    Dim co1 As ChartObject
    Set co1 = AddChartFromBlock(wsSummary, wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(1, 1), cd.Cells(4, 8)), xlColumnStacked100, _
        "Status Mix -- EM / EL / Combined", 420, 260, chart1Colours, "chtStatusMix")

    If Not co1 Is Nothing Then
        ' Data labels showing percentage on the Green segment only (the
        ' others clutter it) -- computed manually since 100%-stacked column
        ' charts do not expose a built-in "show percentage" label type.
        On Error Resume Next
        Dim greenTotals(1 To 3) As Long, rowTotals(1 To 3) As Long
        greenTotals(1) = emGreen: greenTotals(2) = elGreen: greenTotals(3) = emGreen + elGreen
        rowTotals(1) = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen + emOrange + emDraft + emVoided + missedEM
        rowTotals(2) = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen + elOrange + elDraft + elVoided + missedEL
        rowTotals(3) = rowTotals(1) + rowTotals(2)

        Dim pIdx As Long
        For pIdx = 1 To 3
            With co1.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Points(pIdx)
                .HasDataLabel = True
                If rowTotals(pIdx) > 0 Then
                    .DataLabel.Text = Format(greenTotals(pIdx) / rowTotals(pIdx), "0%")
                End If
            End With
        Next pIdx
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1).Value = "(Chart 1 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If

    ' ---- Chart 2 block: ChartData!A8:C16 (rows = 7 bands, cols = EM/EL) ----
    cd.Cells(8, 1).Value = "": cd.Cells(8, 2).Value = "EM": cd.Cells(8, 3).Value = "EL"
    cd.Cells(9, 1).Value = "Green": cd.Cells(9, 2).Value = emGreen: cd.Cells(9, 3).Value = elGreen
    cd.Cells(10, 1).Value = "Pink": cd.Cells(10, 2).Value = emPink: cd.Cells(10, 3).Value = elPink
    cd.Cells(11, 1).Value = "Light Green": cd.Cells(11, 2).Value = emLtGreen: cd.Cells(11, 3).Value = elLtGreen
    cd.Cells(12, 1).Value = "Orange": cd.Cells(12, 2).Value = emOrange: cd.Cells(12, 3).Value = elOrange
    cd.Cells(13, 1).Value = "Draft only": cd.Cells(13, 2).Value = emDraft: cd.Cells(13, 3).Value = elDraft
    cd.Cells(14, 1).Value = "Voided only": cd.Cells(14, 2).Value = emVoided: cd.Cells(14, 3).Value = elVoided
    cd.Cells(15, 1).Value = "Missed FC": cd.Cells(15, 2).Value = missedEM: cd.Cells(15, 3).Value = missedEL

    Dim chart2Colours As Variant
    chart2Colours = Array(RGB(31, 73, 125), RGB(128, 128, 128))

    Dim co2 As ChartObject
    Set co2 = AddChartFromBlock(wsSummary, wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(8, 1), cd.Cells(15, 3)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "Band Counts -- EM vs EL", 420, 260, chart2Colours, "chtBandCounts")

    If co2 Is Nothing Then
        wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1).Value = "(Chart 2 could not be created -- see tables above.)"
        wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
End Sub
