Dim unmatchedNCIDWards As Object
    Set unmatchedNCIDWards = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNCIDWards.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    ' Captured once per row here so Analytics.bas reuses the SAME priority
    ' value the Summary tables are built from, instead of recomputing it --
    ' a chart and its table must never be able to drift apart.
    Dim priArr() As Long
    ReDim priArr(1 To aLastRow)

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' NCID Ward informational column + unmatched-"NCID"-value warning (PART 3.1)
        Dim pocValRaw As String
        pocValRaw = ""
        If pocCol > 0 Then pocValRaw = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))

        Dim isNCIDWard As Boolean
        isNCIDWard = (pocValRaw <> "" And ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw))
        If isNCIDWard Then
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "No"
        End If

        If pocValRaw <> "" And InStr(UCase(pocValRaw), "NCID") > 0 And Not ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
            If unmatchedNCIDWards.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) + 1
            Else
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = 1
            End If
        End If

        ' Duplicate(s) Resolved -- surfaces the visual aid from
        ' DeduplicateEncounters.MarkDuplicateEncounters on the sheet the user
        ' actually sees. That highlighting is applied to fileAws, which is
        ' closed without saving at the end of MainMacro, and this sheet is
        ' populated from a plain .Value array (not a formatted Range.Copy), so
        ' without this column/highlight the "which encounters had more than
        ' one FC ID" visual aid never reaches staff at all.
        Dim encValForDup As String
        encValForDup = Trim(CellStr(fullData(i, encCol)))
        If encValForDup <> "" And resolvedEncounters.Exists(encValForDup) Then
            fullData(i, dupResolvedCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, dupResolvedCol) = ""
        End If

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (Admission Type alone -- Revert A), or 0 = neither.
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(admType) Then
            sec = SEC_EL
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If
            priArr(i) = pri

            encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1
            ClassifyIntoBand pri, greenCt(sec), pinkCt(sec), ltGreenCt(sec), orangeCt(sec), draftCt(sec), voidCt(sec)

            If pri = 98 Then
                ' Known "Draft" family variants (Draft, Draft (CCF Generated),
                ' Draft (ETBS Generated), ...) are an EXPECTED priority-98
                ' outcome, not an anomaly -- only genuinely unexpected text
                ' (blank, typo, brand-new eFC status) goes into the warning
                ' dictionary. Matches the real export: "Draft"/"Draft (CCF
                ' Generated)"/"Draft (ETBS Generated)" are common and normal;
                ' flagging them as "unrecognised" would cry wolf every month.
                Dim statusText As String
                statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"

    ' EL sheet -- always produced (Revert A, 2026-07-30: no longer gated)
    Dim wsEL As Worksheet
    Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL
    HighlightResolvedDuplicateRows wsEL

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    Dim chart1AnchorRow As Long, chart2AnchorRow As Long
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, waterfall, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), voidCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), voidCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        ncidEnc, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid, ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, _
        ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, unmatchedNCIDWards, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), _
        suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, _
        chart1AnchorRow, chart2AnchorRow

    BuildSummaryCharts outWb, wsSummary, chart1AnchorRow, chart2AnchorRow, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), voidCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), voidCt(2)

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster, unmatchedNames

    ' Analytics sheet -- ward gap, day of week, EM turnaround, EL lead time
    ' (Charts 3-6). Built from the same fullData/secArr/priArr the Summary
    ' sheet was built from, not recomputed from fileAws.
    Dim wsAnalytics As Worksheet
    Set wsAnalytics = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_ANALYTICS)
    BuildAnalyticsSheet wsAnalytics, outWb, fullData, aLastRow, secArr, priArr, pocCol, _
        admDateCol, firstCCFDtCol, latestCCFDtCol

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    MsgBox "Unexpected error building output workbook:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    BuildOutputWorkbook = False
End Function

content.content:
228	
229	| Sheet | What it is |
230	|---|---|
231	| **EM** | Emergency admissions, one row per admission, after cleaning |
232	| **EL** | Elective inpatient admissions, same |
233	| **Missed FC** | The follow-up list from File B (absent if you did not supply File B) |
234	| **Summary** | All the figures for the meeting, plus the two headline charts |
235	| **Methodology** | Plain-English explanation of every rule, with this month's numbers |
236	| **Staff Roster Check** | Which staff names matched the roster and which did not |
237	| **Analytics** | Where the gap is by ward, completion by day of week, and turnaround/lead-time charts |
238	
239	### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom
240	
241	**The headline block** comes first -- three rows (Emergency, Elective, Combined),
242	each showing the denominator, the completed count, and the completed percentage
243	in large bold type. This is the number people came for; you should not need to
244	scroll to see it.
245	
246	**Chart 1 (status mix)** follows immediately -- a single stacked bar per
247	category (EM / EL / Combined) showing the full seven-band breakdown at a
248	glance, with the green (completed) share labelled.
249	
250	**Completion status** comes next, as counts and percentages, unchanged in
251	content from before:
252	
253	| Row | Colour | Meaning |
254	|---|---|---|
255	| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
256	| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
257	| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
258	| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
259	| Draft only | Light grey | A form was started but nothing came of it |
260	| Voided/Deleted only | Grey | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
261	| Missed FC | Dark grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
262	| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |
263	
264	That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure. Everything is
265	calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined, with an extra **"of
266	which NCID wards"** block within the elective figures.
267	
268	**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
269	ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
270	field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
271	highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.
272	
273	**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
274	and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.
275	
276	Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
277	that is expected, not a fault.
278	
279	**Chart 2 (band counts, EM vs EL)** comes after the status tables -- the same
280	seven bands as Chart 1, but as absolute counts side by side rather than a
281	percentage mix, which is where the 100%-stacked chart above hides real volume
282	differences between EM and EL.
283	
284	**The warnings block** follows: unrecognised FC statuses, NCID wards not in
285	your configured list, and unmatched staff names.
286	
287	**The reconciliation waterfall** is last, under the heading "Reconciliation --
288	for checking, not for the meeting". It walks from the raw file down to the
289	final total, one line per filter, ending in a balance check. It is at the
290	bottom because it is a working-check for you, not a meeting figure -- see
291	section 6 for what to do with it.
292	
293	### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages
294	
295	If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
296	counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
297	out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.
298	The same n<30 rule applies to the Analytics sheet's lead-time buckets.
299	
300	### 5.3 The Analytics sheet
301	
302	Four blocks, each with a chart:
303	
304	| Block | Chart | What it shows |
305	|---|---|---|
306	| Point of Care ward gap | Chart 3 | Top 10 wards by not-done count -- the most actionable view in the workbook |
307	| Day of week | Chart 4 | EM completion rate by admission weekday, against the overall EM rate |
308	| EM turnaround | Chart 5 | Admission to 1st CCF creation, bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h, plus median hours to first and to latest CCF |
309	| EL lead time | Chart 6 | Elective lead time (days ahead of admission the FC was first created) vs. completion rate -- includes a "No CCF created" bucket at 0%, shown deliberately rather than hidden |
310	
311	---
312	
313	## 6. Checking that it worked
314	
315	Do this every month before circulating the report.
316	
317	**Step 1 -- the balance check.** The reconciliation waterfall is now at the
318	bottom of the Summary sheet, under "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the
319	meeting". At the bottom of it there is a check row. If it flags a mismatch, do
320	not circulate the report. Send it to whoever maintains the macro.
321

| Sheet | What it is |
|---|---|
| **EM** | Emergency admissions, one row per admission, after cleaning |
| **EL** | Elective inpatient admissions, same |
| **Missed FC** | The follow-up list from File B (absent if you did not supply File B) |
| **Summary** | All the figures for the meeting, plus the two headline charts |
| **Methodology** | Plain-English explanation of every rule, with this month's numbers |
| **Staff Roster Check** | Which staff names matched the roster and which did not |
| **Analytics** | Where the gap is by ward, completion by day of week, and turnaround/lead-time charts |

### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom

**The headline block** comes first -- three rows (Emergency, Elective, Combined),
each showing the denominator, the completed count, and the completed percentage
in large bold type. This is the number people came for; you should not need to
scroll to see it.

**Chart 1 (status mix)** follows immediately -- a single stacked bar per
category (EM / EL / Combined) showing the full seven-band breakdown at a
glance, with the green (completed) share labelled.

**Completion status** comes next, as counts and percentages, unchanged in
content from before:

| Row | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
| Draft only | Light grey | A form was started but nothing came of it |
| Voided/Deleted only | Grey | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
| Missed FC | Dark grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |

That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure. Everything is
calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined, with an extra **"of
which NCID wards"** block within the elective figures.

**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.

**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.

Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
that is expected, not a fault.

**Chart 2 (band counts, EM vs EL)** comes after the status tables -- the same
seven bands as Chart 1, but as absolute counts side by side rather than a
percentage mix, which is where the 100%-stacked chart above hides real volume
differences between EM and EL.

**The warnings block** follows: unrecognised FC statuses, NCID wards not in
your configured list, and unmatched staff names.

**The reconciliation waterfall** is last, under the heading "Reconciliation --
for checking, not for the meeting". It walks from the raw file down to the
final total, one line per filter, ending in a balance check. It is at the
bottom because it is a working-check for you, not a meeting figure -- see
section 6 for what to do with it.

### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages

If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.
The same n<30 rule applies to the Analytics sheet's lead-time buckets.

### 5.3 The Analytics sheet

Four blocks, each with a chart:

| Block | Chart | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| Point of Care ward gap | Chart 3 | Top 10 wards by not-done count -- the most actionable view in the workbook |
| Day of week | Chart 4 | EM completion rate by admission weekday, against the overall EM rate |
| EM turnaround | Chart 5 | Admission to 1st CCF creation, bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h, plus median hours to first and to latest CCF |
| EL lead time | Chart 6 | Elective lead time (days ahead of admission the FC was first created) vs. completion rate -- includes a "No CCF created" bucket at 0%, shown deliberately rather than hidden |

---

## 6. Checking that it worked

Do this every month before circulating the report.

**Step 1 -- the balance check.** The reconciliation waterfall is now at the
bottom of the Summary sheet, under "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the
meeting". At the bottom of it there is a check row. If it flags a mismatch, do
not circulate the report. Send it to whoever maintains the macro.

**Step 2 -- do the totals look plausible?** Compare against last month. A
completion rate that jumps by more than a few points, or a total admission count
that moves sharply, usually means an export problem rather than a real change.

**Step 3 -- is the missed FC count sensible?** It should be small. Hundreds means
the export is wrong.

**Step 4 -- read the warnings.** The Summary sheet flags unrecognised FC
statuses, NCID wards not in your list, and unmatched staff names. None of these
stop the report, but they tell you what to fix for next month.

### Reference figures -- June 2026

If you re-run the June 2026 export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`) with
an empty roster and no File B, you should get exactly:

difference is fully explained and the tool is the more accurate of the two:

  rate -- it is exactly the kind of slip this tool removes.

matches the accepted figures *and* explaining where it is more accurate is what

`1st CCF ETBS`/`Latest CCF ETBS` are currency (dollar amounts), not
timestamps -- an earlier version of CLAUDE.md's column reference conflated
"AY: Latest CCF ETBS" with the real timestamp column. Corrected: `AT` = 1st
CCF Creation Date-Time, `AX` = Latest CCF Creation Date-Time, `AY` = Latest
CCF LOS, `AZ` = Latest CCF ETBS (dollars). Turnaround/lead-time calculations
use AT/AX exclusively, resolved by header text as always.

### Chart failure handling
Every chart is created via `ChartHelpers.AddChartFromBlock`, which is
guarded with `On Error` and returns `Nothing` on any failure. Every call
site checks for `Nothing` and writes a one-line note on the sheet instead --
a charting failure never aborts report generation. The tables remain the
deliverable; charts are presentation.
